title: Degeneracy and nonlinear subfamilies of NFSRs
summary: Find necessary and sufficient criteria for when NFSR output families are generated by a smaller register, including arbitrary nonlinear subfamily inclusion.

formal_statement.body: Given nonsingular binary NFSRs $f$ and $g$, characterize when $\mathcal G(g)\subseteq\mathcal G(f)$ and when $f$ is degenerate because its output sequences can be generated by a smaller NFSR. The result must cover arbitrary nonlinear inclusions and distinguish them from the source's special cascade-decomposition form and from the already studied affine subfamilies.

scope.domain: Output-sequence families and degeneracy of binary nonlinear feedback shift registers
assumptions: The registers are NFSRs over F_2
A smaller generating register defines degeneracy
G(g) subseteq G(f) is the subfamily relation
scope.unresolved_remainder: The source's cascade algorithm and earlier affine results do not characterize arbitrary nonlinear subfamily inclusion or all degeneracy cases.

provenance.note: The 2025 TIT paper explicitly cites Zhang et al. (2019) in its affine-subfamily antecedent chain. The 2019 paper is the earliest text-confirmed source in that chain to leave arbitrary nonlinear NFSR subfamilies open.
